{{Quote|To the Forward Command Center, take me.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Yoda to a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|Clone trooper pilot]] during the First Battle of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
A '''Forward Command Center (FCC)''' was a mobile [[Command center|command station]] used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
From the FCC, a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]&mdash;such as a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]]&mdash;and their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]]&mdash;such as a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]]&mdash;could command their [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and direct the battle. It was a small, circular platform that allowed [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to monitor the battle.<ref name="AOTC" />

==History==
Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and clone trooper [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[CRC-09/571]] were stationed in the first Republic FCC during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. Here, CRC-09/571 informed Yoda that the forward positions of the clones were advancing on [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces. Yoda's order to target the nearest [[Core ship/Legends|Core ship]] was relayed to the [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] units from the FCC.<ref name="AOTC" /> Although the center lacked weapons, it was heavily guarded by two [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic gunships]] and many [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]].

A similar center was used by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]].<ref name="CWC8">{{CW|8}}</ref>
